He created Barefoot Landing, combining shops, restaurants and entertainment around a lake, and developed Barefoot Resort. With his son Jake, he also established Alligator Adventure, a visitor attraction housing alligators and other reptiles.

long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Sam Puglia wanted the designers at Barefoot Resort to see one another's work as construction progressed. He commissioned four golf courses simultaneously, bringing together designs by Greg Norman, Davis Love III, Tom Fazio and Pete Dye. The courses opened on the same day, creating a destination where visitors could play contrasting layouts without travelling between separate resorts.

The wider development combined golf with homes and had to meet demanding rules governing runoff into the Intracoastal Waterway. Its drainage measures included underground pipes that allowed water to soak into the ground and the use of stormwater to restore wetlands. The project also preserved a Carolina Bay wetland.
